title: Age-Check Extra for Late Express Orders Carrying Alcohol
content:
**Northgate Store and Online Orders — late-express age-check extra.** On a Northgate Same-Day Delivery express order, alcohol lines are handed over only after an age check, so an adult must stay home for the delivery. The late-express credit counts the order's alcohol lines:

| Alcohol lines on the order | Extra percentage |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10 percent |
| exactly one | 5 percent |
| none | nothing |

Lines are counted, not units: one line of a six-pack bought twice is one alcohol line.
